prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up shot of a vintage typewriter, its black metal frame and mechanical details partially visible at the bottom of the frame. A sheet of off-white paper is loaded into the typewriter, with the words "Amor verdadero" typed in bold, red ink at the center of the page. The lighting is warm and soft, casting gentle shadows and creating a nostalgic, intimate atmosphere. The focus is sharp on the typed words and the typewriter’s platen, while the background fades into a subtle blur, emphasizing the tactile texture of the paper and the precision of the typewritten letters. The overall color palette is muted, dominated by earthy tones and the striking contrast of the red text. The composition is symmetrical and cinematic, evoking a sense of romance, reflection, and timelessness.
